# Mnemoverse — Persistent Memory API for AI Agents

> One memory. Every AI tool. Write once, recall anywhere.

Mnemoverse is a persistent memory API for LLM agents.

The guide for AI agents is maintained with the documentation on mnemoverse.com. This file only points there; read the files below for setup, tools and pricing.

## Docs

- [llms.txt](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/llms.txt): the maintained guide for AI agents — install steps, rules for agents, endpoint reference, MCP tool list, pricing
- [llms-full.txt](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/llms-full.txt): the complete Mnemoverse API documentation in plain text
- [Getting Started](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/getting-started): store, query, and give feedback on your first memory
- [Where each tool works](https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/tool-availability): which Mnemoverse MCP tools each host gets
